text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> p95 latency > 1800ms in eu-west for inference-service :rotating_light: auto-page to @oncall
maya: acked on PD, stepping in. looking at dashboards now
rohan: seeing spike on p95 and p99, tail looks like tokenization stage. total error rate stable though
alice: linking dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/inference/eu-west?panel=latency
maya: thanks. can someone check autoscaler logs and recent deploys? runbook says check recent model rollouts
rohan: quick grep of autoscaler shows lots of scale events at 14:02 UTC, but pods healthy. maybe cold tokenizers on new nodes
jack: reprod query from logs: `request_id=abc123 tokenization_ms=1200 kv_cache_miss=1` few of these repeated
maya: can we route traffic to dedicated fallback model (smaller variant) temporarily? that reduced tail in previous incidents
alice: initiating routing policy change -> `route:set eu-west -> model:small-1, pct:30` (will monitor)
incident-bot: Routing change applied by alice, change-id=chg-9876
rohan: p95 dropped from 1850ms to 950ms after reroute. p99 still elevated ~2200ms
maya: okay, good improvement. next: investigate hotspot keys / hot sharded clients. jack, do you have hotkey list?
jack: pulling hotkey heatmap now. a single customer ID shows 37% of requests to a few nodes
maya: reached out to customer success to notify affected customer and ask for rate shaping. cs-ticket #CS-4382 opened
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook step 3: If routing reduces latency but p99 remains > threshold, enable kv-cache warming and increase batcher concurrency
rohan: kv-cache warming started (warm-job-12). batcher concurrency bumped +20%
alice: will keep routing split for 10 more minutes then consider full cutover if stable
maya: handoff note for next oncall: ongoing p99 tail, routing at 30% to small model, warming job running, CS notified. if p99 stays >2.0s escalate to SRE lead @jack
rohan: logging snippet for runbook: ```
[14:04:11] warm-job-12: warming key batch 240
[14:06:05] route: applied change-id=chg-9876
[14:07:30] latency.p95=950ms latency.p99=2200ms
```
jack: thanks — I'll stay looped in. if we see another spike, plan is full 100% cutover and customer-facing status update
maya: ack. moving to monitoring phase. will post postmortem template if we go to incident state :clipboard:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved (auto-close) -> condition back under threshold for 2m. alert-id=pd-77654 :white_check_mark:
maya: marking this thread for postmortem follow-up. good job team :thumbsup:
